TradingView Lightweight Charts v5.0.9, standalone production build, unmodified.

Source:  npm package lightweight-charts@5.0.9
         https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/lightweight-charts@5.0.9/dist/lightweight-charts.standalone.production.js
License: Apache License 2.0 (LICENSE in this folder, from the same package).
         The package ships no NOTICE file (https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/lightweight-charts@5.0.9/NOTICE returns 404).
         The attribution logo is turned off (attributionLogo: false) because it injects a <style>
         element that the site's Content-Security-Policy blocks; the page credits TradingView with a
         link to tradingview.com next to the demo and in the footer instead. The Android app keeps the logo.
